blocks.text: Bring effortless elegance and lasting comfort to your outdoor living space with the Clare View outdoor sofa, crafted for both style and durability. Built with a sturdy eucalyptus wood frame, this piece features tapered accents and slat styling, treated with a 5-step protective finish for enhanced weather resistance. Plush, all-weather cushions and four coordinating throw pillows are wrapped in high-performing Nuvella fabric, designed to resist fading and maintain its beauty season after season. The zippered covers make cleaning simple—just use mild soap and water, or a bleach solution for tougher stains. Inside, an all-weather foam core wrapped in soft polyester ensures superior comfort for lounging, entertaining or relaxing under the sun. Perfect for patios, decks or poolside spaces, this outdoor sofa combines timeless design with low-maintenance materials for a worry-free outdoor experience. Assembly required.

items.label: CUSHIONED SOFA
items.value: Looking for something more refined in your outdoor space? This sofa fulfills with comfy cushions and eucalyptus wood that's protected to weather the elements with ease

items.label: DURABLE DESIGN
items.value: Made of eucalyptus wood with a 5 step protective coating process for maximum durability. Zippered cushions are wrapped in high performance Nuvella fabric. Includes 4 throw pillows

items.label: TOUCH OF ELEGANCE
items.value: Styled in light, airy neutrals, this sofa impresses with tapered touches and slat styling that's so chic by an outdoor coffee table or underneath an umbrella (sold separately)

items.label: GREAT ON A PATIO
items.value: This seating is perfect for 3 on a balcony or by the pool; just add a lounge chair or fire pit (sold separately) and you're all set. This couch measures 81" W x 35" D x 37" H

items.label: ASSEMBLY REQUIRED
items.value: Easy-to-follow instructions, hardware and tools included. Imported fabric and fill

items.label: Item Dimensions D X W X H
Additional Features
items.value: Fade Resistant, Removable Cushion, Stain Resistant, UV Resistant, Weather Resistant

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Clean fabric with mild soap and water, let air dry; for stubborn stains, use a solution of 1 cup bleach to 1 gallon water
